ValidationRule.description: Block Care Enquiry conversion unless status and qualification prerequisites are met.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = 'Care Enquiry', ISCHANGED(IsConverted), IsConverted, OR( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status)) <> 'Ready to Convert', ISBLANK(TEXT(CareOrch_Funding_Type__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(CareOrch_Requested_Care_Type__c)), ISBLANK(CareOrch_Target_Admission_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Conversion is allowed only when the lead is in Ready to Convert and all enquiry qualification fields are complete.
